preface.block: Draft Regulations laid before Parliament under section 47(3) and (6)(a) of the Medicines and Medical Devices Act 2021, for approval by resolution of each House of Parliament.

formula.name: enactingText
formula.p:
The Secretary of State makes these Regulations in exercise of the powers conferred by sections 10(1), 11, 12(1)(a), (b) and (c), and 43(2) of the Medicines and Medical Devices Act 2021
2021 c. 3. (“the Act”).
In accordance with section 10(2) of the Act, the Secretary of State’s overarching objective in making these Regulations is to promote one or more of the matters specified in that subsection.

The Secretary of State has consulted in accordance with section 45(1) of the Act and has set out in the consultation document, in accordance with section 45(3) of the Act, a summary of the Secretary of State’s assessment of the matters mentioned in section 10 of the Act.
A draft of this instrument has been laid before Parliament and approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament in accordance with section 47(3) and (6)(a) of the Act.

content.p: These Regulations may be cited as the Veterinary Medicines (Amendment etc.) Regulations 2024 and come into force 21 days after the day on which they are made.
These Regulations extend to England and Wales and Scotland.

intro.p: In paragraph 57 (adverse reactions to product administered in UK)—

p.mod: in paragraph (a) for serious adverse reaction substitute adverse event in respect of an animal;
for adverse reaction substitute adverse event;

content.block: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

blockContainer.heading: EXPLANATORY NOTE
blockContainer.subheading: (This note is not part of the Regulations)
blockContainer.p: These Regulations amend the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/2033, “the 2013 Regulations”) in respect of Great Britain only.
